prompts.prompt: The three photos in the reference image are all the SAME real young Korean man. Reproduce his face EXACTLY: same face shape, same eyes and eyelids, same eyebrows, same nose, same lips, same short black hairstyle, same age. Do not beautify or change his features. Vertical 4:5 photorealistic news-documentary still, like a TV news archive shot. Keep the bottom 40% fairly dark and simple (space for a headline). No readable text, no logos, no watermarks. Scene: he sits on a small stage at an intimate bookstore book-talk event, holding up a plain beige hardcover book toward a small seated audience seen from behind, warm bookstore lights and bookshelves behind him.
